label: Bible Study
prompt: O God, thou art my God; early will I seek thee: my soul _____ for thee, my flesh longeth for thee in a dry and thirsty land, where no water is;
verse: O God, thou art my God; early will I seek thee: my soul thirsteth for thee, my flesh longeth for thee in a dry and thirsty land, where no water is;
note: A psalm of David 'in the wilderness of Judah' — the dry land outside matched the thirst inside.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Therefore I will _____ unto the LORD; I will wait for the God of my salvation: my God will hear me.
verse: Therefore I will look unto the LORD; I will wait for the God of my salvation: my God will hear me.
note: When friends and family let him down, Micah says: I will look unto the LORD — my God will hear me.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And he was there in the wilderness forty days, tempted of Satan; and was with the wild _____; and the angels ministered unto him.
verse: And he was there in the wilderness forty days, tempted of Satan; and was with the wild beasts; and the angels ministered unto him.
note: Only Mark mentions that during the forty days of temptation Jesus was 'with the wild beasts.'

label: Deep Water
prompt: Ephraim, he hath mixed himself among the people; Ephraim is a _____ not turned.
verse: Ephraim, he hath mixed himself among the people; Ephraim is a cake not turned.
note: A flatbread burned on one side and raw on the other — Hosea's picture of half-hearted Ephraim.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And he went a little further, and fell on his face, and prayed, saying, O my Father, if it be possible, let this cup pass from me: _____ not as I will, but as thou wilt.
verse: And he went a little further, and fell on his face, and prayed, saying, O my Father, if it be possible, let this cup pass from me: nevertheless not as I will, but as thou wilt.
note: Gethsemane's hinge word: 'nevertheless not as I will' — the prayer that turned the night toward the cross.
